verdict.rationale: Shopify offers a documented Storefront API (GraphQL) for building custom commerce experiences on any platform, plus Hydrogen, a first-party React framework for headless storefronts with hosting included via Oxygen, and CLI tooling to scaffold headless projects. Community evidence corroborates that Shopify's platform is generally more capable than alternatives, though some devs criticize API/doc quality generally (not specific to headless/Storefront API). Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer testimonials specifically building a headless Hydrogen storefront (most corroboration is first-party docs).
